market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a fringe candidate who received 0.01% of valid votes in the 2022 presidential race and has no significant polling support for 2026. The second-place finisher in Brazil's first round will be a major figure like Lula, Bolsonaro, or a leading governor; Santos has no plausible path to that position. The market-implied 5.8% chance vastly overstates his true near-zero probability.
evidence_points: Santos secured only 0.01% of the vote in 2022, placing far outside the top two.
Leading 2026 polls show Lula, Tarcísio de Freitas, and Bolsonaro as frontrunners, with no indication of Santos as a serious contender.
Historical pattern: fringe PSOL candidates never finish second in presidential elections.
sources_consulted: Recent polling aggregators (e.g., Poder360, Datafolha) for 2026 scenarios
